input_contract: compute_morphology_reading expects float64/float32-castable array of shape (3, 1000) -- the 3 contiguous 10s windows of one 30s reading, already band-passed/detrended/robust-normalized by preprocess(). Deterministic and label-independent: same input always produces the same output, no randomness, no cross-patient statistics.
output_contract: float32 array of shape (13,), equal to the mean of the 3 per-window 13-dim feature vectors.
